decisions.reason: The responsive template has not appeared on the website since 2018, which suggests it has little value, but it costs almost nothing to keep and it complements hosting, so the option stays open while the risk of quiet removal is noted as high.

Premium support is central to the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock service model and earns recurring revenue at low incremental cost, so keeping it is justified even though recent evidence is missing.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and core strategic direction, and the missing archive pages show nothing about its value, so continued commitment rather than abandonment is warranted.
